reasons.action: The request explicitly asks the figure to perform a new behavior (addressing the crowd), which overrides the subject plate's static fighting stance and camera-facing pose.
reasons.medium: No rendering change was requested, so the live-action reference remains the rendering guide.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change was requested; the observed charcoal technical jacket and worn black boots are retained from the reference.
reasons.lighting: No instruction about light, its source, direction or quality was given; reference lighting stands.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or movement was specified; being in front of a crowd does not itself define framing.
reasons.palette: No color or tonal grading request was made; the reference palette governs.
